result.title: Reframe: Observation-Aligned Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Visual Reasoning
result.summary: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) and multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) offer complementary routes to post-training. For visual agents, however, tool use presents two related challenges. Models may overlook useful tool-returned observations, while poorly grounded actions can limit the evidence available for subsequent distillation. We introduce Reframe, a post-training framework that treats the observation state, rather than only the output distribution, as an object of alignment. First, Ground-Drop-GRPO (GD-GRPO) trains spatial and temporal specialists with evidence-aware rewards and stochastic removal of the original visual input, encouraging them to acquire grounded evidence and use the returned observations. Second, Observation-Gated-MOPD (OG-MOPD) replaces deficient tool actions with canonical ones mid-rollout and resumes distillation from the repaired observation. The two stages complement each other, as learning to rely on tool-returned observations can help the policy benefit from observation repair. Neither stage requires a task-specific SFT cold start. Extensive experiments over 14 image and video benchmarks demonstrate that Reframe outperforms both Mix-RL and vanilla MOPD. Ablation results show that GD-GRPO increases observation dependence and tool gain compared with outcome-based GRPO.

AI.brief_summary: Reframe 是一个面向视觉 agent 的后训练框架，将「观察状态」而非仅输出分布作为对齐对象：GD-GRPO 通过证据感知奖励并随机移除原始视觉输入，训练专家依赖工具返回的观察；OG-MOPD 则在 rollout 中把失败的工具调用替换为规范动作，并从修复后的观察继续多教师 on-policy 蒸馏。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接触及多模态推理中视觉证据是否被真正使用的训练与评价问题，其 observation-gated 蒸馏和随机遮挡原始图像的做法，可供核查能否作为检验 LVR 中视觉旁路与证据依赖的诊断或监督信号。
